rules.identical: the evaluation prompt, whitespace-normalized and lower-cased, equals a training row's prompt or hindsight prompt
rules.near_duplicate: word 8-gram shingles of the prompt, minus the set's own layout (in >= 20% of a sample of its prompts, plus its question texts), >= 50% present among the training shingles, then Jaccard >= 0.5 against one training row (top 20 candidates)

item_index: 0-based line number in the split's file
